base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a spectacular nebula blazing with hot pinks, electric blues and a brand-new shade of green, pulsing stars and painterly drifting gas clouds — except at its edges, where all colour has been drained to a dull uniform filing-cabinet grey. Lighting: vivid neon glow fading to flat grey.
In the shot: the Tomkin-Mobile, a sleek, aggressive, low-slung racing car with the armoured bulk of a naval battleship, mirror-polished chrome and copper panels, retractable feathered metal wings that fold like a barn owl's, a tailpipe that puffs lavender-coloured bubbles, and a roof rack on top.
Camera: Epic wide reveal, the car small against the nebula.
Action: The Tomkin-Mobile glides into the Neon Nebula — blazing hot pinks, electric blues and a brand-new green, pulsing stars like heartbeats.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: ethereal shimmering hum fading to a dull flat drone, ambience of ethereal hum, distant cosmic chimes.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
